preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have admin privileges via setAdminAddress)
Contract must have positive token balance in its address(this) account (from accumulated bounsFee)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As owner, call sumTheBounsPool() with appropriate date strings (yesToday, twoYesToday) to transfer half of contract's token balance to dayPoolBouns[yesToday]. Then manipulate dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday] via sumBounsPiece() to set a high piece value. Finally, call receiveBounsToken() (if eligible) or wait for users to claim rewards at inflated rates, allowing you to drain the bonus pool. Alternatively, repeatedly call sumTheBounsPool() to accumulate unclaimed rewards in dayPoolBouns mapping.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has owner-only functions that allow manipulation of the bonus pool system. The owner can call sumTheBounsPool() to transfer half of the contract's token balance to a specific day's bonus pool, then use sumBounsPiece() to arbitrarily set the bonus piece value. This allows the owner to drain the bonus pool by setting inflated piece values and claiming rewards.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, use sumTheBounsPool() to move contract balance to bonus pool, set inflated piece value with sumBounsPiece(), then claim bonus via receiveBounsToken() after ensuring eligibility conditions are met.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Impersonate owner using vm.prank()
2. Get date strings using getDays()
3. Call sumTheBounsPool() to transfer contract balance to bonus pool
4. Call sumBounsPiece() to set high piece value
5. Ensure attacker has enough tokens and no sell records
6. Set bounsTime to enable claiming
7. Call receiveBounsToken() to claim inflated bonus

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract accumulates bonus fees (6% of transfers) in its own address. As owner, we can manipulate the bonus pool system to drain these accumulated fees. We need to ensure the contract has token balance first, then use owner privileges to move that balance to the bonus pool and set inflated piece values.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Use deal() to give tokens to the contract (simulating accumulated bounsFee). 2. Use deal() to give tokens to attacker to meet minBounsJoin requirement. 3. Impersonate owner to manipulate bonus pool. 4. Claim bonus.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use deal() to inject tokens to contract address (simulate accumulated fees). 2. Use deal() to give attacker enough tokens to meet minBounsJoin. 3. Impersonate owner to call sumTheBounsPool() and sumBounsPiece(). 4. Set bounsTime to enable claiming. 5. Call receiveBounsToken() to claim bonus.
attempts.failure_reflection: The previous PoC failed because the owner didn't have enough tokens to transfer to the attacker. We tried to transfer 1e21 tokens but the owner's balance was insufficient. We should use `deal()` to directly inject tokens to addresses instead of relying on transfers from the owner.
